targets.rawSql: SELECT tool_name, countIf(status != 'ok') AS failures, count() AS total, round(countIf(status != 'ok') / count(), 4) AS failure_rate FROM spans WHERE step_type = 'tool_call' AND tool_name != '' AND start_time >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY failure_rate DESC
SELECT run_id, round(sum(cost_usd), 6) AS total_cost_usd, sum(input_tokens) AS input_tokens, sum(output_tokens) AS output_tokens FROM spans GROUP BY run_id ORDER BY total_cost_usd DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT step_type, tool_name, round(quantile(0.5)(latency_ms)) AS p50, round(quantile(0.95)(latency_ms)) AS p95, round(quantile(0.99)(latency_ms)) AS p99, count() AS total FROM spans GROUP BY step_type, tool_name ORDER BY p99 DESC
SELECT run_id, tool_name, input_hash, count() AS repeats FROM spans WHERE step_type = 'tool_call' AND input_hash != '' GROUP BY run_id, tool_name, input_hash HAVING repeats >= 4 ORDER BY repeats DESC
